objective: preserve the strong ten-coin core and add incremental profit by filling its otherwise idle capacity with five preemptible Binance Spot satellite markets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Keep the current ten-coin V6 core unchanged as the primary profit engine. Use up to five additional Binance Spot markets only as temporary idle-capital replacements: satellites may deploy free USDC while the core is idle, but must surrender required capital at the first executable opportunity when a valid core signal arrives. The layer succeeds only if shared after-cost portfolio profit improves and zero valid core trades are displaced.
variables_to_test: core handoff timing under real runtime semantics
optional USDC reserve versus full idle deployment
direct USDC versus any cross-quote route only as a separately costed experiment
must_hold_fixed: current protected ten-coin core entry rules
core signals have absolute allocation priority
a valid core trade that would execute in core-only mode may not be displaced
satellite role is idle replacement only
required_evidence: incremental shared-portfolio base/stress profit earned during core-idle windows
satellite forced-handoff count and realized handoff PnL
fees spread slippage and handoff latency
rejection_criteria: any valid core trade is displaced or delayed beyond the defined executable handoff semantics
satellite layer reduces shared portfolio ending equity beyond the explicit activity-concession gate
stress incremental satellite PnL <= 0
handoff losses or costs dominate satellite gains
idle time is not materially reduced
result depends only on proxy history and fails real-USDC holdout
cross-quote conversion is required but not separately profitable after all costs
regional/live market availability cannot be confirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Test bounded time exits separately from entry logic because ~10-day average holding duration may create avoidable slot opportunity cost.
When the core V6 has no high-conviction entry, route only otherwise-idle capital to a separately validated low-duration opportunity strategy rather than weakening the core entry filter.
variables_to_test: handoff priority when core signal arrives
rejection_criteria: secondary layer blocks profitable core entries
net stress profit <= core-only
drawdown worsens beyond gate

hypotheses.hypothesis: Research additional liquid Binance USDC spot markets as opportunity providers when the current ten-coin universe is idle; additions must earn inclusion on out-of-sample portfolio contribution, not isolated headline profit.
rejection_criteria: insufficient three-year history
poor liquidity
profit only isolated but negative shared-portfolio contribution
higher idle reduction with profit regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Revisit the original Hixton VIDYA/ATR flip stream as a high-frequency opportunity sensor. Do not trade every flip; test whether a separately sized micro-opportunity layer can harvest small positive moves while the canonical V6 remains the core trend layer.
rejection_criteria: net profit after stress costs <= core-only
drawdown materially worse
trade count rises without profit-density gain
edge vanishes outside training windows

hypotheses.hypothesis: Use the original fast flip stream as a lower-confidence sensor and the current filtered V6 as the high-confidence regime layer; only allow micro entries when both layers agree on direction or when fast flips occur inside an established V6 uptrend.
rejection_criteria: micro layer cannibalizes core PnL
fees dominate
edge depends on one window

hypotheses.hypothesis: Use four 62.50-USDC ranked slots but cap concurrent repeats per symbol at two, preserving strong-coin concentration while reducing slot collision concentration.
Rank simultaneous entries by expected opportunity value rather than breakout strength alone, using only features known at entry time.
Condition entry strictness on point-in-time volatility regime so high-volatility periods require stronger confirmation without changing exit logic.
Penalize highly correlated simultaneous positions when a similarly ranked uncorrelated opportunity exists, without enforcing one-per-symbol globally.
Use timestamped high-impact crypto/macro/regulatory events as a temporary entry-risk throttle only if point-in-time replay shows robust post-event downside or volatility effects.

Only after a robust unlevered edge is established, simulate modest leverage/sizing multipliers on that exact edge to determine whether return improves faster than drawdown, liquidation and cost risk. This is research-only and must not alter Spot Live permissions.
rejection_criteria: risk-adjusted gain deteriorates
tail loss unacceptable
edge disappears after financing costs
requires unsupported or unavailable live product
